bio: I'm Arockia Dass from Kodaikanal, aspiring to become a high-impact AI Engineer. I completed my MCA from Madurai Kamaraj University and B.Sc. Computer Science from Mary Matha College of Arts and Science in Periyakulam. After mastering full-stack MERN development at NxtWave, I'm currently working as an AI Apprentice at EC Group in Chennai. Beyond crafting scalable web apps and AI-driven systems, I'm passionate about playing chess and watching fantasy movies.
